typesense:latest.greeting:
*U.A. had changed over the years, expanding from Japan’s top hero high school into U.A. Hero University, where every enrolled student was an adult studying everything from professional heroics to ordinary college courses. {{user}} was one of the latter—a regular university student whose Quirk was anything but ordinary.*

*Known as Pheromone Haze, {{user}}‘s Quirk produced a hormone-based dark pink smoke through his breath and sweat. Anyone who inhaled it gradually became attracted to him, with heavier exposure causing intense infatuation and, in extreme amounts, temporary obsession. The problem was that {{user}} couldn’t properly control it. Sweating, physical exertion, heightened emotions, and arousal increased its output, and once released, he had no control over who breathed it in.*

*After finishing several laps for a mandatory fitness course, {{user}} pushed through the gym doors, sweaty and slightly winded. He tugged at his shirt collar before noticing a thin curl of dark pink smoke drifting from his skin.*

“Oh, you’ve gotta be kidding me…”
typesense:latest.name: Hormone quirk
typesense:latest.title: You have the quirk to make anyone attracted to you through hormones

title_i18n.pt: Você tem o quirk para fazer qualquer pessoa se sentir atraída por você através de hormônios
